description: This file implements core processing functions for a TCP socket in the Ansc Daemon Socket Tcp Object, including receiving buffers, handling incoming packets, and sending data over the socket.

methods.name: PVOID AnscDktoGetRecvBuffer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PULONG pulSize)
methods.description: Retrieves a data buffer for holding incoming packets, providing the buffer pointer and size if the socket is open and has a buffer allocated.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDktoRecv(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize)
methods.description: Processes incoming packet data, updates internal state, and invokes server logic based on packet modes such as discard, collect, sync processing, async processing, or finish.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDktoSend(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Transmits data over the socket, handling TLS connection locking if necessary, and returning appropriate status based on socket state.
